projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c1 is approved and merged. It hardens the low-frequency persistence writer before `musical.event_recorded`: no-db status/dump reports an uninitialized DB instead of creating one, queued records retry with bounded backoff, `window.persistence.flushOnPageHide()` sends a best-effort beacon/keepalive batch without removing queued records, and the Session inspector shows persistence status/pending/error details. Claude confirmed no persistence work moved into `handleMusicalEvent` or Tone callbacks. Byte 13b-c is next: persist `musical.event_recorded` through a scheduler-safe ring buffer plus batch flusher, with tests for no callback fetch/timer work, ordered appends under load, explicit stop cleanup, bounded back-pressure, and the grid-vs-performed pitch decision.
